list.name: FounderOS
list.description: An open-source, single-operator business command center: run a one-person operated company as AI-assisted departments (comms, funnel, social, finances, agents, and a knowledge graph) from one live dashboard.

list.name: pentagi
list.description: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks

list.name: WeKnora
list.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.

list.name: multica
list.description: Make humans and AI agents work as one team — open-source and self-hostable.

list.name: Pentest-Swarm-AI
list.description: Autonomous penetration testing using a swarm of AI agents. Orchestrates recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting specialists with ReAct reasoning — supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. Built with Go and 7+ native security tools.

list.name: semantic-router
list.description: An open, programmable decision layer for models and compute.

list.name: open-code-review
list.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

list.name: keda
list.description: KEDA is a Kubernetes-based Event Driven Autoscaling component. It provides event driven scale for any container running in Kubernetes

list.name: ai-native-callcenter
list.description: Self-hosted, API-first AI call center. Realtime voice bots answer every call, human agents take over without a drop. Full REST + SSE API with OpenAPI spec to embed in your product. FreeSWITCH + OpenAI Realtime / Qwen, one Go binary.

list.name: terraform
list.description: Terraform enables you to safely and predictably create, change, and improve infrastructure. It is a source-available tool that codifies APIs into declarative configuration files that can be shared amongst team members, treated as code, edited, reviewed, and versioned.

list.name: bifrost
list.description: Open-source, high-performance AI gateway that works as your LLM gateway, MCP gateway and agent gateway. One OpenAI-compatible API for 10,000+ models, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys, budgets and MCP Code Mode. Works with any SDK or agent and adds under 200µs of overhead at 5k RPS.

list.name: livekit
list.description: End-to-end realtime stack for connecting humans and AI

list.name: cli
list.description: The official Lark/飞书 CLI tool, maintained by the larksuite team — built for humans and AI Agents. Covers core business domains including Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheets, Calendar, Mail, Tasks, Meetings, and more, with 200+ commands and 20+ AI Agent Skills.

list.name: new-api
list.description: A unified AI model hub for aggregation & distribution. It supports cross-converting various LLMs into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. A centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.

list.name: CubeSandbox
list.description: Instant, Concurrent, Secure & Lightweight Sandbox for AI Agents.
